title: IGM iterative rounding + injectivity barrier (Bommes 2013)
description:
**Depends on PATCH-40 v2 (aligned-parametrization linear solve).** Implements the iterative-rounding loop + injectivity barrier on top of the v1 single-solve aligned parametrization.

**Algorithm (Bommes 2013):**
1. Start from PATCH-40's aligned parametrization (real-valued).
2. Iterative rounding loop:
   a. Find the most-confident non-singularity corner whose floating UV is closest to integer.
   b. Test injectivity: would rounding cause a triangle flip? (orientation check on (u,v))
   c. If yes: reject, try next candidate.
   d. If no: pin as hard constraint, re-solve linear system.
   e. Repeat until all singularities sit at integer UV AND all triangles positively oriented.
3. Log-barrier penalty on triangle orientation flip — keeps all triangles positive-oriented through the loop.

Reference: Campen 2014 thesis Stage 3c + Bommes-Campen-Ebke-Alliez-Kobbelt 2013. Per-stage diagnostic baseline at Ixdar/ixdar-app/test/resources/qgp/baseline-hand/stage2_uv_corners.tsv (metriko's IGM output on Hand-tri-30k.obj).
definition-of-done: 1. Output: integer UV at all singularities, every triangle positive-oriented in (u,v). 2. Cube + subdivided sphere produce valid integer-grid maps. 3. On Hand-tri-30k.obj, output matches metriko's stage2_uv_corners.tsv at non-singularity corners within 1e-3 (modulo seam shifts).
testing-plan: 1. Cube: singularities pinned to integers, all triangles oriented. 2. Sphere: same. 3. Stress: synthetic injectivity-violating round, verify barrier rejects. 4. Hand-tri-30k.obj: match metriko UV stats (depends on PATCH-46 scaling fix).
